Graphic designer and design historian. Her 1985 Pratt thesis on Black designers became “Black Designers Missing in Action”, published by Print in 1987. What I took from their work: Writing down who is missing is design work too.

Artist, Minister of Culture of the Black Panther Party. He shaped the look of The Black Panther newspaper from 1967. AIGA Medal, 2015. What I took from their work: Design can speak for a community, in its own visual language.
Graphic designer, writer and educator. Senior art director at Rolling Stone from 1987 to 2002. AIGA Lifetime Achievement Medal, 2008. What I took from their work: Lettering can carry a whole voice.

Designer, founder of Off-White. Founded Off-White in 2013. Named artistic director of Louis Vuitton menswear in 2018. What I took from their work: You do not need permission to work across disciplines.
Cameroonian tech entrepreneur. Founded AppsTech in 1999. Chairs ActivSpaces, a tech hub in Buea. What I took from their work: You can build from Africa and be taken seriously everywhere.
